concept.name: El Jefes Taqueria
concept.tagline: El Jefe's Taqueria, Central Oakland, Pittsburgh

menu.name: Chicken Burrito
menu.description: Flour tortilla filled with grilled chicken, rice, beans, and your choice of toppings.
menu.imagePrompt: A foil-wrapped chicken burrito cut in half on a paper takeout tray, rice and beans visible at the edge, flat overhead lighting, no text, no people.

menu.name: Steak Burrito
menu.description: Flour tortilla packed with seasoned steak, rice, beans, and toppings of your choice.
menu.imagePrompt: A foil-wrapped steak burrito on a paper takeout tray with a small cup of salsa, flat overhead lighting, no text, no people.

menu.name: Chicken Tacos (3)
menu.description: Three soft corn tortillas with grilled chicken, onion, cilantro, and salsa.
menu.imagePrompt: Three soft corn tacos with chicken, diced onion and cilantro, in a paper boat tray, flat overhead lighting, no text, no people.

menu.name: Veggie Bowl
menu.description: Rice and black beans topped with grilled vegetables, fresh salsa, and guacamole.
menu.imagePrompt: A takeout bowl of rice, black beans, grilled peppers and onions topped with guacamole and salsa, no text, no people.

menu.name: Quesadilla
menu.description: Grilled flour tortilla filled with melted cheese and your choice of protein.
menu.imagePrompt: A cut cheese quesadilla on a paper takeout tray with sour cream and salsa cups beside it, no text, no people.

menu.name: Chips and Queso
menu.description: Crispy tortilla chips served with warm house queso.
menu.imagePrompt: A paper cup of melted cheese queso beside a pile of crispy tortilla chips on a takeout tray, no text, no people.

menu.name: Horchata
menu.description: Chilled cinnamon rice drink served over ice.
menu.imagePrompt: A clear plastic cup of creamy horchata over ice with a cinnamon dusting, takeout lid, no text, no people.

brand.logoPrompt: A flat two-color mark pairing a simple taco silhouette with a bold sans-serif monogram 'EJ', in red and dark brown on cream.
brand.voice: Friendly and direct, speaking to customers as hungry regulars who want fresh food built exactly their way, at any hour.
